West of House
You are standing in an open field west of a white house, with a boarded front door.
There is a small mailbox here.

steps.subgoal: explore starting area and find entry to house

steps.obs: Opening the small mailbox reveals a leaflet.

steps.obs:
(Taken)
"WELCOME TO ZORK!

ZORK is a game of adventure, danger, and low cunning. In it you will explore some of the most amazing territory ever seen by mortals. No computer should be without one!"
steps.reasoning: I've read the leaflet. Now I should explore around the house to find a way in, since the front door is boarded. I'll head north around the house to look for another entrance.
steps.subgoal: explore around the house to find an entrance

steps.obs:
North of House
You are facing the north side of a white house. There is no door here, and all the windows are boarded up. To the north a narrow path winds through the trees.
steps.reasoning: I'm circling the house looking for an entrance. The front is boarded, north side has no door either. I should continue around to the east side where the classic entrance (kitchen window) is located.
steps.subgoal: find an entrance into the house

steps.obs:
Behind House
You are behind the white house. A path leads into the forest to the east. In one corner of the house there is a small window which is slightly ajar.
steps.reasoning: There's a small window slightly ajar behind the house - this is the classic entrance point. I should open it and enter.
steps.subgoal: enter the house through the window

steps.obs: With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
steps.reasoning: The window is now open, so I can enter the house through it to begin exploring inside for treasures.
steps.subgoal: enter the house through the window

steps.obs:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water
steps.reasoning: I'm now inside the kitchen. I should explore the contents - check the sack and bottle, then continue exploring west into the living room to find the classic starting treasures and equipment like the lamp and sword.
steps.subgoal: explore kitchen and gather useful items

steps.obs: Opening the brown sack reveals a lunch, and a clove of garlic.
steps.reasoning: The sack contains a lunch and garlic. Garlic is useful later against the vampire bat in the Barrow. I should take both items before moving on to explore the rest of the house.
steps.subgoal: gather useful items from kitchen before exploring further

steps.reasoning: I already grabbed the garlic; the lunch is also useful for later. I'll take it before moving on to explore the living room for the lamp and sword.
steps.subgoal: gather useful items from kitchen before exploring further

steps.reasoning: I have garlic and lunch. Next I should get the lamp and sword from the living room, then head down to the cellar. Moving west takes me from kitchen to living room.
steps.subgoal: explore living room for lamp and sword

Above the trophy case hangs an elvish sword of great antiquity.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
steps.reasoning: I'm in the living room and can see both the elvish sword and the brass lantern. I should take the lantern first since I'll need light for the underground areas.
steps.subgoal: collect lamp and sword from living room

steps.reasoning: I have the lamp. Now I need the elvish sword above the trophy case before heading down to the cellar.

The Troll Room
This is a small room with passages to the east and south and a forbidding hole leading west. Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
steps.reasoning: The troll is blocking all exits and attacking me. I need to fight it with my sword to clear the way.
steps.subgoal: defeat the troll to proceed deeper into the underground

steps.obs:
The troll takes a fatal blow and slumps to the floor dead.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
steps.reasoning: The troll is dead and the passages are now clear. I should explore the room's exits to continue mapping the underground and finding treasures. East, south, and west (through the hole) are all options - I'll continue exploring systematically.
steps.subgoal: explore underground passages and find treasures
